about: Practise against the landlord. In turn 3 the opponent cites a section and the coach invents a deadline; both are rejected and retried.

sent.text: Landlord Mr. Iyer in Chennai is holding my Rs 60,000 deposit. I vacated on 30 September 2026 and left the flat clean.

assistant.content:
You vacated the flat in Chennai on 30 September 2026 and left it clean, and your landlord Mr. Iyer is holding your Rs 60,000 deposit.

If your state has adopted the Model Tenancy Act or a similar law, the landlord must refund the deposit after deducting only your actual liabilities, and the deposit cannot exceed two months' rent for residential property. [1]

Your rental agreement is a contract, so if the landlord wrongfully withholds your deposit, you may claim compensation for losses that naturally arise from this breach. [2]

If you need legal help, you may contact the District Legal Services Authority or the NALSA helpline for free legal aid if you qualify under their criteria. [3]

citations.title: Security deposit under the Model Tenancy Act
citations.caveat: Rent law is state-specific. Whether this applies depends on your state and whether you have a lease or a leave-and-licence agreement.
citations.summary: The Model Tenancy Act is a model law. It applies only in states that have passed a tenancy law based on it. Where it applies, a residential deposit cannot exceed two months' rent (six months for non-residential), and the landlord must refund it when taking back vacant possession, after deducting only the tenant's actual liabilities.

citations.title: Breach of a written or oral agreement
citations.caveat: Recovering money through a civil court has its own time limits and procedure. Ask a lawyer or the District Legal Services Authority early.
citations.summary: A rent agreement or an employment agreement is a contract. When one side breaks it, the other side can claim compensation for loss that naturally arose from the breach. Remote or indirect losses are not covered.

citations.title: Free legal aid
citations.caveat: The income limit varies by state.
citations.summary: Women, children, members of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes, persons with disabilities, industrial workmen, people in custody and people below the income limit can get a free lawyer. Call the NALSA helpline 15100 or visit your District Legal Services Authority.

sent.text: Sir, I vacated on 30 September and left the flat clean. Please return my Rs 60,000 deposit.

assistant.content:
Practice mode: I'll play the landlord. Say what you'd say to them. Switch mode any time to stop.

Landlord says: I understand your concern, but there were some minor damages that needed repair after you left, so I had to use part of the deposit for that. I'll send you the details soon.

Coach: Politely ask for a written itemized list of the damages and the repair costs to verify the deductions. This keeps the conversation factual and professional. [1] [2]
